name: @jamesbrooks/warp
description: Pure functional event-driven devkit. Event -> Gate -> Stream -> StreamLog, plus Axiom as an enforced primitive and a unified dispatch (exact-cache / pre-generation-filter / population / cascade / axiom-gate / score-retain / escalate). Zero dependencies, zero coupling to any consuming project.
author: James Brooks
